stemMarkdown:
A survey conducted on a shopping website found that 90 percent of respondents prefer shopping online. The site concludes that most people prefer shopping online.

The reasoning is flawed because:

options.markdown: the people surveyed are not representative of the general population
90 percent is not a large enough majority to draw conclusions
the survey did not ask respondents to explain their preference
online shopping has grown steadily in recent years

solutionMarkdown: Everyone surveyed was already visiting a shopping website, so they were predisposed to prefer online shopping. A self-selected sample cannot support a claim about people in general. This is **selection bias**, and it is the flaw regardless of how large the percentage is.
